svg.title: SitePilot technical architecture
svg.desc: Three-page source-grounded architecture diagram for SitePilot, covering browser study workflow, proposal and planning truth, and Google technology status.

g.text: System boundaries, canonical study state, rendering adapters, and export authority
The published testing build and local runtime use the same browser-first state model.
Next.js / React · one active renderer branch
No account, database, or shared case
store is present in this release.
Outputs from the accepted study state
Cloud Run / Vertex AI / Cloud Build are
configured in source, but not live-verified here.
Solid: local fallback · Dashed: authenticated path
Proposal intent is reviewable; geometry, figures, and planning status remain SitePilot authority
LOCAL FALLBACK VERIFIED · LIVE MODEL UNVERIFIED
• Local proposal flow: deterministic templates, explicitly labelled.
• Parcel and road are rectangular study representations.
• KDH is not demonstrated without explicit landscape/permeability.
• “Within supplied limits” is not statutory compliance.
Google technology architecture and gap register
Confirmed source integration, configurable boundaries, and the smallest credible next work
NO LIVE AUTHENTICATED OR PAID CALL MADE
Solid Google markers mean source and local behavior were inspected.
Imported by the shared AI client and proposal contract.
Local fallback and structured proposal response were tested.
Three proposals are schema-validated before use.
No live model invocation was made for this document.
Dashed Google boundaries are present in source or deployment config.
Vertex AI via Cloud Run gateway
ADC/IAM + bearer secret boundary in source
Still needed: hosted URL, IAM execution,
model response, logs, revision, cost evidence.
Dotted components are proposals, not current capabilities.
Gemini plan → read-only tools → approval → report
Address and context; never cadastral authority
Only implement with owner-approved scope and billing.
Capture hosted revision, logs, model metadata
Google technology does not equal formal hackathon compliance. The agentic workflow, hosted proof, owner attestations, licensing, and video remain separate gates.
